title: Net
description: Schema for a net — a first-class connectivity object. Per OBJECT-MODEL.md §17. Composes identity (id, kind, origin) and adds members + optional type / description / extensions. Adopted in v3 Sprint 13.

description.description: Human-readable note about the net's role in the circuit.

type.description: Net classification per OBJECT-MODEL.md §17.3. Optional — defaults to unspecified. Specialized classes (mixed-signal, differential, clock, high-speed) are deferred until real fixtures demand them.

members.description: Instances connected to this net. Each member is {instance, terminal}. Minimum 2 — a net with 0 or 1 members can't form a circuit. Cross-FK provides a defense-in-depth net-underpopulated check at world-load time. Per OBJECT-MODEL.md §17.4.

terminal.description: Free string identifying the instance's terminal/pin connected to this net (e.g., 'anode', 'cathode', 'positive_terminal', 'in', 'out'). Cross-FK validation checks these against the referenced device's declared terminals (an unknown-terminal error) when the device declares its terminal taxonomy.
